gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO BAKENG SA AFTER EFFECTS - DILO TŠE MPSHA
Kgatišo 9.2.8  -  Oktobore 2026
================================================================================

Panele bjale e bolela DIPOLELO TŠE 132, go na le DEMON SLAYER THEMES tše mpsha tšeo di nago le sabole
yeo e segago di-button tšeo o di gateletšago, gammogo le ditokišo tše mmalwa tša layout le Windows.

PELE O THOMA
- Kenya godimo ga kgatišo ya gago ya bjale ka ZXP installer ya gago ya ka mehla, ke moka o thome
  After Effects gape ka lekga le tee.
- Dipeakanyo tša gago, theme, di-preset le di-expression tše o di bolokilego di a bolokwa.

E MPSHA: PANELE KA DIPOLELO TŠE 132
- Dipeakanyo tša Flex > POLELO bjale e laetša dipolelo tše 132, le lepokisi la go nyaka. Kgetha ye nngwe
  gomme panele ka moka e a fetoga: di-tab, di-button, di-tooltip, melaetša.
- Polelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ile ya fetolelwa ke AI go tšwa go panele ya Seisimane, e sego lentšu ka lentšu.
  Maina ao o a bonago porojekeng ya gago (maina a dilera, maina a di-effect) a dula e le a Seisimane
  gore a dule a swana le After Effects.
- Popup ya “dilo tše mpsha” le yona e fetoleditšwe, go tloga kgatišong ye.

E MPSHA: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
- Dipeakanyo tša Flex > THEME SELECTOR di na le sehlopha se sefsa sa DEMON SLAYER se se nago le di-theme tše 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen le Kokushibo.
- Šuthiša mouse godimo ga panele gomme selo sa theme se a e latela: meetse, malakabe, legadima,
  dirurubele, matlakala a dipalesa, moholi le tše dingwe. Ge mouse e ema,
  se nyamelela gannyane-gannyane.
- Click button gomme sabole ya semelo seo e a e sega. Swara button ya mouse ya ka letshadi gomme e tšwela
  pele go sega; e swara ka nako ya disekhondi tše ka bago 2.5 gomme e a phatloga.
- E dirilwe gore e dule e le bonolo: di-effect di šoma feela ge o šuthiša goba o click, gomme di ba bonolo
  go feta ka noši dikhomphutheng tše di diegago. Tima AMBIENT EFFECTS go Theme Selector gore o boloke
  mebala feela.

E FETOŠITŠWE: DI-BUTTON TŠE DI LEKANEGO KA DI-THEME KA MOKA
- Di-button tše di šomago le tše kgolo ka di-theme tša mebala ga di sa šomiše gradient ya moriti go tloga
  godimo go ya fase. Ke mmala o tee o lekanego wo o nago le glow ye bonolo, ka fao di bonagala
  di hlwekile gape di balega kaone.

E TOKIŠITŠWE
- Karata ya layisense le popup ya “dilo tše mpsha” di be di ka bulega godimo ga e nngwe. Bjale ga di sa
  tshelana, gomme letšwao la MPSHAFATŠA ga le sa khupetša di-button tša ka godimo
  ga panele.
- Go UI SCALE 125% le 150%, di-window tše dingwe (bjalo ka Dipeakanyo tša Flex) di be di ka ba telele go
  feta panele, ka fao button ya tšona ya go tswalela e be e ya ka ntle ga pono. Bjale window ye nngwe
  le ye nngwe e a lekana le bogolo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe.
- Windows: AutoCaptions e be e ka re “NVIDIA DRIVER E TŠOFETŠE KA GO FETIŠA BAKENG SA GPU CAPTIONS” go
  di-card le di-driver tše mpsha (RTX 40 le 50 series). Bjale e bala thekgo ya CUDA ya driver ka nepo
  gomme e diriša GPU ya gago.

TŠE DI SA FETOGAGO
- Layisense, activation le link ye nngwe le ye nngwe di šoma ka mo go swanago le pele.
- Di-tab tše dingwe ka moka le didirišwa di šoma ka mo go swanago le ka 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE BAKENG SA PREMIERE PRO - DILO TŠE MPSHA
Kgatišo 2.2.8  -  Oktobore 2026

Di-caption tša CAPTION STACK bjale ke di-template tša Motion Graphics TŠE DI KA LOKIŠWAGO tšeo di nago le editor ya
nnete, go na le AUDIO STUDIO e mpsha le MARK AUDIO BEATS, panele e bolela DIPOLELO TŠE 132, UI SCALE e
fihlile go ULTIMATE, gomme go na le DEMON SLAYER THEMES tše mpsha.

PELE O THOMA
- Kenya godimo ga kgatišo ya gago ya bjale ka ZXP installer ya gago ya ka mehla, ke moka o thome
  Premiere Pro gape ka lekga le tee.
- Dipeakanyo tša gago, theme le di-preset di a bolokwa.

E MPSHA: CAPTION STACK - DI-CAPTION TŠE DI KA LOKIŠWAGO (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Di-caption bjale di bewa e le di-template tša Motion Graphics tše di ka lokišwago (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, ye mpsha ye e lego default go Premiere Pro 2026). Ka morago ga go bea,
  fetola lentšu le lengwe le le lengwe, font, mmala, bogolo, boemo, glow, outline, box,
  animation goba nako ka panele ya Essential Graphics ya Premiere.
- Output > DISWANTŠHO e sa dutše e bea lentšu le lengwe le le lengwe e le seswantšho se se nago le sebopego sa
  nnete, ge o rata seo.
- Di-template di tla le panele. Ga go na se se swanetšego go download.

E MPSHA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview bjale e bontšha frame ya nnete ya video ya gago ka fase ga caption ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
- Goga caption go e šuthiša, diriša khutlo go fetola bogolo le ntlhana ya ka godimo go e dikološa,
  double-click lentšu go le lokiša. WHOLE CAPTION e šuthiša mantšu ka moka mmogo,
  ONE WORD e šuthiša lentšu le tee.
- Kgetha ge phetogo e dirišwa go di-caption ka moka goba go caption ye feela, gomme boloka
  di-layout tša gago gore o di diriše gape.
- Dibopego tše 10 tše mpsha tša GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow le Superb.

E MPSHA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Kgetha audio clip, kgetha effect gomme o gatele DIRIŠA. Tšohle e šoma
  khomphutheng ya gago.
- Di-preset tše 30 tša click e tee: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse le tše dingwe. Bea di-effect
  tše o di ratago, o di rulaganye gape goba o time e tee.
- Reverb e boloka mogatla wa yona: modumo o tšwela pele ka morago ga go fela ga clip, gomme o bewa gore
  ga go selo se se lego go timeline ya gago se tla ngwalwa godimo.
- Didirišwa: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  le Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER e arola koša go di-vocal le mmino (goba di-stem tše 4). E download model ya yona la mathomo
  gomme e go botšiša pele.
- PREVIEW e go dumelela go theeletša disekhondi tše ka bago 8 ka switch ya Original / Processed. Sephetho
  se ya go audio track ye e lokologilego gomme clip ya gago ya mathomo e a homišwa,
  ga e phumulwe le gatee.

E MPSHA: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Kgetha clip ya mmino go timeline gomme o gatele MARK BEATS: Flex e hwetša di-beat gomme e
  oketša di-marker tša sequence godimo ga tšona, gore di-cut tša gago di tsenelane ka
  nepo le mmino.
- Kgetha hits KA MOKA, KICKS goba SNARES, bea sensitivity, gomme o swaye beat e nngwe le e nngwe goba
  beat ya bobedi goba ya bone e nngwe le e nngwe.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS e phumola feela di-marker tšeo Flex e di oketšitšego. E šoma khomphutheng
  ya gago.

E MPSHA: PANELE KA DIPOLELO TŠE 132

E MPSHA: UI SCALE

  Window ye nngwe le ye nngwe e a lekana le bogolo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe.
